additional_info.body:
Guten Tag,
der Fehler trat in meiner Anwesenheit am 06.01. auf.
Beide Ladestationen haben den linken Anschluss auf "Außer Betrieb".
Zu dem zeigt der rechte Anschluss beider Ladersäulen während eines Ladevorgangs "Laden abgebrochen" an, wobei weiterhin das Fahrzeug geladen wird. Der Ladevorgang lässt sich bei beiden Ladesäulen nicht abbrechen, sodass eine Notentriegelung am Fahrzeug gemacht werden muss um den Stecker wieder aus dem Fahrzeug zu ziehen.

additional_info.subject: ID0470599-DC/Si-D/DE- [Multi] Charging Station Issue CRM:03277000028
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0470599
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000666
Charger ID / Serial No.:
1bhhGK
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
The client has reported
an issue with the DC1 cable temperature sensor on both charging station (
1bhhG, 3R0uae
)
, which has been confirmed after our checks. Please attend site and carry out the following steps:
•           Please measure confirm the values by measuring directly on the cabl
es coming from the CCS. If you see that the value doesn't change with charging, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure the 1kOhm until you reach the KF12/13.
o          P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
•           If you get 1kOhm until the State Monitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
o          Or replace the State Monitor.
•           I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor.
If check is fine, please proceed with replacing the cable.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Ivan Perotto
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
